docs/how-it-works.md:24:8. **Report.** For each request, pi-action posts a `🤖 pi Response` comment (or `❌ pi Error`), and adds 🚀 (or 😕) to the request. docs/how-it-works.md:25:9. **Save.** pi-action pushes the thread. Then it writes the git commands that read the thread to the log and the job summary. See [Read a thread](threads.md#read-a-thread).
